questions.question: How did Israel finally capture Ai?
options: A flood that breached the walls
A direct assault on the gate
A siege that starved the city

questions.question: What did Joshua do after the victory, at Mount Ebal?
options: Held a great feast to mark the victory
Built an altar and read the law to the people
Rested the whole army and divided up all the plunder
Crowned a king to rule over the land
questions.answer: Built an altar and read the law to the people

questions.question: Joshua read all the words of the law, the blessings and the curses, to the people.
Israel took Ai by setting an _____ behind the city.
